verdict: PASS — hardened plugin 11/11; previous revision as negative control 6/11 (the 5 closed paths fail); session-log regression still ✓6 ✗0 !0.
howToReproduce: node scripts/verify-lane-role-presentation.cjs (expect 11/11). Negative control: copy the previous revision to /tmp and run LANE_PLUGIN_PATH=/tmp/lane-role-presentation.PREV.mjs node scripts/verify-lane-role-presentation.cjs (expect 5 failures). Reload the preset generation with dev_reload_preset preset=agent-lanes and confirm its output names lane-role-presentation.mjs -> ?v=N.

environment.note: The live host still runs the previous plugin generation for THIS session; the new generation is mounted by the next new session (?v=1).

findings.claim: The plugin resolved delegation depth from session.header.delegationDepth alone, while the harness authority is Math.max(header, options.subagentDepth) (packages/subagent/subagent/src/depth.ts:28-36).
findings.whyItMatters: Today both fields are written from the same resolveChildDepth (child-agent.ts:49, options at :114, header at :152-154), so they agree. Any creation path that records only the runtime option would have left a real child in PTC with zero warning — a silent run_code escape, i.e. exactly what the whole preset exists to prevent.
findings.fix: Resolve with Math.max(header ?? 0, options.subagentDepth ?? 0), and additionally treat origin === 'subagent' (written in the same childSessionMeta, child-agent.ts:138-156) as a child signal. A malformed options.subagentDepth is reported and the header is used (the harness throws a TypeError there; failing loud but still flipping is the safe direction for a security boundary).

findings.claim: dev_reload_preset silently did nothing for this preset: its matcher /(name: \.\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.mjs)(\?v=\d+)?/g requires an UNQUOTED reference, and the yml had name: './lane-role-presentation.mjs'.
findings.evidence: Tool output before the fix: "[agent-lanes] 无相对 .mjs 引用（无需热更新）". After removing the quotes: "[agent-lanes] lane-role-presentation.mjs -> ?v=1".
findings.whyItMatters: Without the ?v= bump the host's ESM URL cache keeps serving the OLD plugin generation to every new session, so HANDOFF §4's documented loop ('reload, then open a new session') would have appeared to work while verifying stale code.
findings.fix: Reference is now bare (name: ./lane-role-presentation.mjs) and the yml carries ?v=1; yml re-parsed successfully (24 top-level rows, 4 role rows intact).
